title: PIMP Activation
concept_summary: Built as slow americana, it stays with someone letting the porch become a habit of waiting. The pressure comes from waiting made tense by what never arrives. It leaves the release in waiting left in place instead of closure.

signal_stack.identity: someone making a habit out of waiting on the porch
signal_stack.emotional_arc: Waiting -> repetition -> absence still running the room
signal_stack.genre_framework: slow americana, maybe a little southern gothic feel but subtle

lyrics:
[Intro]
porch light buzzing
truck that never pulls in

[Verse 1]
porch light buzzing
bugs hitting the bulb
same porch, same waitin'

[Pre-Chorus]
empty chair
truck that never pulls in
absence keeps the whole thing moving

[Chorus]
truck that never pulls in
porch light still on

[Bridge]
ain't much to tell in it
still the light stays on

[Outro]
porch light buzzing
truck that never pulls in
